# NAutomation Labs
> nA labs, the robotics arm of NAutomation Labs, builds robots that Indian machine shops can teach themselves. OrderShed is the parts arm and Decibyl is the AI-agents arm.

- Robots: https://nautomationlabs.com/robots
- Software: https://nautomationlabs.com/software
- Jobs the robots are built for: https://nautomationlabs.com/jobs
- Roadmap and vision: https://nautomationlabs.com/roadmap
- About: https://nautomationlabs.com/about
- Contact: https://nautomationlabs.com/contact · office@nautomationlabs.com

The robots are in development. Robot images on the site are concept renders.
